verdict.rationale: A production user calls Better Auth "the best open-source option for TypeScript developers" (comm-9), and another commenter's criticism of its codebase (comm-16) implies the source is publicly readable. However, no first-party documentation in the pack names a license or points to a source repository. Missing for 10: first-party statement of the license (e.g. MIT), a documented public source repository link, and independent confirmation of the license terms.
